candidate_claim: Not a candidate report. This is the deferred half of an adjudicated correction. CORR-GPT-T2C-CURRENCY-20260905 established from OCIMF that the publication is BMP Maritime Security, 1st Edition, 2025, updated during 2026, and that there is no second edition. It corrected nine sites inside QB4_H#q13 and recorded, rather than swept, the same wrong label surviving outside that card.
candidate_verdict: UPHELD - the propagation is a direct consequence of a fact already adjudicated and externally verified. No new factual theory is advanced here.
authority: OCIMF identifies the publication as BMP Maritime Security, 1st Edition, 2025, updated during 2026 with the activist-boarding guidance. Six co-publishers: BIMCO, ICS, IMCA, INTERCARGO, INTERTANKO and OCIMF. No second edition has been established. Registered as SRC-BMPMS-2026 in docs/sources/MIW_SOURCE_REGISTRY.json, where the id encodes the RETRIEVAL YEAR and not an edition number. THIS RECORD ADDS NO SOURCE EVIDENCE OF ITS OWN. It carries the T2C finding to the cards T2C did not touch, which is why it is a propagation family and not an investigation.

note: SCOPE. PROPAGATION ONLY. The activist-boarding content of the 2026 update, the six-publisher list, the three replaced publications, the 31 March 2025 launch facts, the global-not-region-locked proposition and every BMP5 technique block are deliberately untouched. QB4_H#q13 is NOT declared here and is byte-identical across this change: it is CORR-GPT-T2C-CURRENCY-20260905's card, and this record does not claim its bytes. PREDECESSOR GUARDS. NEITHER EXPIRED, and the reason is worth keeping. Both are written to assert that the T2C RECORD still reports the open defect, not that the defect is still live in the corpus: they read the manifest's propagation block and the review document, and this sweep changes neither. That is the correct shape for a guard over a deferred item, and it is what the batch-guard expiry defect class on this repository's record is the counter-example to. A guard that had instead asserted 'QB4_H#q2 still says 2026' would have turned red the moment the repair landed, and a reader could not then tell a repair from a regression. Checked: tools/oral/validate_correction_gptt2c.py, 72 checks, 0 FAIL after this sweep; action taken: NONE. No predecessor gate was edited by this record.

artefacts.rationale: The entry asserted 'A second edition followed in 2026' and that the publication 'has now superseded its own first edition twice over'. Both are the defect this family exists to remove, stated in the study document that teaches candidates about it. Replaced with the publisher label, a cross-reference to entry 80, and the statement that 'the 2026 edition' is itself a trap. THE ENTRY'S OWN GREP: SKIP DISCIPLINE IS WHY THIS SURVIVED: entry 54 is marked GREP: SKIP for a different reason - it quotes wording it rejects - and a phrase scan that trusts that marker walks past a live assertion sitting three lines above the quoted one.
